Q6113.reason: Arson requires malice (intent or reckless disregard of an obvious risk), and merely forgetting to turn off the stove is negligence, so he is not guilty.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle is the alternation of diastole (relaxation and filling) and systole (contraction), and 'rest' is not a separate phase.

Q8294.reason: Ice is less dense than liquid water because its hydrogen-bonded crystal framework is open, and that is why pressure melts it and the solid-liquid line slopes negatively.
